caption: The drawing depicts a square textile or embroidery pattern set against a black background. The main section is a pale blue square bordered by a decorative lace edge in white with a repeating geometric motif. Inside the blue square, the composition is divided into four triangles by diagonal lines forming a diamond shape in the center of the square. Within two of these triangles, there are intricate, geometric, yellow designs arranged as diamonds. The four remaining triangular sections (at the corners of the square) each feature hand-drawn flowers in various colors: one cluster shows pink flowers, one shows reddish-brown and yellow flowers with green leaves, one displays yellow flowers with dark centers, and one corner contains red-pink buds with green leaves. The entire drawing consists mainly of blues, whites, yellows, greens, pinks, and reds, emphasizing the floral and geometric motifs. The lace and lines are delicately rendered, and the flowers appear naturalistic.
title: Pair of Satin Pillow Shams
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
